messages:
Eleni (Partnerships): Quick ask - partner wants a compact ref-arch + Terraform starter for CloudPartner Y. Need owners and a simple publish checklist.

Kai (DevEx): I can scaffold modules + examples (examples/quickstart-llm). Will add semver and CHANGELOG.

Jon (Cloud): Provide k8s helm + single-host systemd. Tests should run on amd64/arm64.

Priya (Security): I'll draft minimal IAM snippets, KMS notes, and an audit-log pointer.

CI Bot: CI triggered - matrix: arch=[amd64,arm64] gpu=[none].

Eleni (Partnerships): Timeline: PR in 48h, review 48h, partner review 72h. Owners: Kai (iac/docs), Jon (packaging/tests), Priya (security). Thanks :thumbsup:

Kai (DevEx): sample usage:
```hcl
module "cp_y" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood/partner-iac.git//modules/cloudpartner-y"
  region = var.region
  node_count = 2
}
```
